summary: The requirement document asks for a video meeting service for small companies and coaching institutes, used from a browser or phone apps and sold as monthly plans. It covers scheduling, live video for up to 100 people, screen sharing, chat, host controls, recording, captions, plan payments and usage reports, with one year of support.

evidence.quote: Participants shall join from a link in the browser without installing anything, or from the Android and iOS apps.

stories: As a participant, I can join a meeting from the Android or iOS app

evidence.quote: Participants shall chat with everyone or privately during the meeting.

stories: As a participant, I can chat with everyone or privately during the meeting

evidence.quote: The system shall show live captions in English while people speak.

stories: As a participant, I can see live English captions while people speak

evidence.quote: Companies shall buy a monthly or yearly plan and pay by card or UPI; plans renew automatically.

stories: As a company administrator, I can buy a monthly or yearly plan and pay by card or UPI

evidence.quote: Company administrators shall add and remove their staff and see usage reports: meetings held, minutes used and recordings stored.

stories: As a company administrator, I can see usage reports of meetings held, minutes used and recordings stored

evidence.quote: Employees of companies on the business plan shall sign in with their company's Google Workspace or Microsoft account.

stories: As an employee of a business-plan company, I can sign in with my company's Google Workspace or Microsoft account

other_features.name: Meeting scheduling and invitations
other_features.description: Hosts schedule meetings with date, time and agenda and invite people by email with a calendar invite.
stories: As a host, I can schedule a meeting with a date, time and agenda
As a host, I can invite people by email so that invitees get a calendar invite

evidence.quote: Hosts shall schedule a meeting with a date, time and agenda and invite people by email; invitees get a calendar invite.

other_features.name: Live video and audio meetings
other_features.description: Live video and audio for up to 100 participants with a gallery view and the active speaker shown large.
stories: As a participant, I can join a live video and audio meeting of up to 100 people
As a participant, I can see a gallery view with the active speaker shown large

evidence.quote: Meetings shall carry live video and audio for up to 100 participants, with a gallery view and the active speaker shown large.

other_features.name: Screen sharing
other_features.description: Participants share their screen during a meeting.
stories: As a participant, I can share my screen

other_features.name: Host meeting controls
other_features.description: Hosts use a waiting room, mute or remove participants and lock the meeting.
stories: As a host, I can use a waiting room
As a host, I can mute or remove participants
As a host, I can lock the meeting

evidence.quote: Hosts shall use a waiting room, mute or remove participants, and lock the meeting.

other_features.name: Meeting recording and sharing
other_features.description: Hosts record a meeting; recordings are stored in the cloud for 30 days and shared by link.
stories: As a host, I can record a meeting
As a host, I can share a recording by link within 30 days

evidence.quote: Hosts shall record a meeting; recordings shall be stored in the cloud for 30 days and shared by link.
Participants shall join from a link in the browser without installing anything, or from the Android and iOS apps.
The vendor shall support the product for one year after launch.
